name: 48152 · Livonia, MI
findings: ZIP 48152 (Livonia) has 156 nonprofit organizations. 80 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 69 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48152 (Livonia) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 48152 (Livonia) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 69 organizations here; 27% of all organizations here have no identified type.
